text:
The summary is factually accurate. The dates, the $64,000 contractor cost, the $298,000 of $455,000 spend, the four dependent reports, the sponsor's absence and the 24 October update all match the source. It softens Finance's condition on the partial go-live (acceptable only if no month-end reports depend on payroll) into "may not be acceptable," which is a fair reading but less precise. It also omits that the team is proceeding on the current plan while Tomas documents the payroll system, which a manager might want to know. The main problem is length: the body is roughly 130 words, and with the title closer to 145, so it breaks the explicit under-120-word limit. Accuracy is high, but the limit violation and the minor omission weigh against it.

Score: 5
